title: Each family of the quality gate and where it stands
description: What GET /api/v1/gates/trust answers, and `ingestion gates trust list --json` prints: the ladder that every family climbs, and each family's standing, by connector and then prompt version.

rule.description: The ladder. A straight run of run agreeing marks earns asking, a person's yes climbs to rung 1, and each further run of run lowers the share by lower, down to floor.

shares.description: The share of drops shown on each rung from 1 up.
